The '''Mantooine system''' was located in the [[Atrivis sector/Legends|Atrivis sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="AOC" /> It contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Mantooine/Legends|Mantooine]].<ref name="ACPV" /> [[Smuggler/Legends|Smuggling]] [[Spice/Legends|spice]] in the Mantooine system was considered to be a capital offense.<ref name="FTS">{{JournalCite|2|The Free-Trader's Guide to Sevarcos}}</ref>
